author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Learn how to use Meta Muse, Meta’s personal AI assistant, in this step-by-step tutorial for beginners. In this video, we walk through account setup, connecting Gmail and Google Calendar, researching and booking a restaurant, drafting and sending emails, scheduling recurring tasks, saving preferences, and uploading a PDF for personalized recommendations. You’ll also learn where to find task ideas, check free-plan usage limits, and review the permissions you give Muse.

Host: Kevin Stratvert

📚 RESOURCES
- Try Meta Muse: https://muse.ai
